sn17.38-43:1.2: dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
sn17.38-43:1.3: idhāhaṃ bhikkhave ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi
sn17.38-43:1.11: tamenaṃ passāmi aparena samayena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūtaṃ pariyādinna cittaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsantaṃ.
sn17.38-43:1.12: evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābha sakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
sn17.38-43:1.14: uppannaṃ lābha sakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma na ca no uppanno lābhasakkāra siloko cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti.
